A list of spells available to be learned by the Sorcerer class upon level up.

Overview

The level column indicates spell level, not class level. Sorcerer spells are Known spells and cannot be changed after they are learned through a level up.

Sorcerer spells will use the caster's Charisma modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
